Therefore, all three exception types are not avoided in this context.
answer: LinkageError is not avoided; ExceptionInInitializerError is not avoided; ClassNotFoundException is not avoided.
remark: LinkageError can be triggered if the class is found but linking fails (e.g., missing dependencies or incompatible binary). ExceptionInInitializerError occurs if the class's static initializer throws an exception. ClassNotFoundException occurs if the class name (from SERVICES_WITH_CACHE) does not correspond to a known class or if the class cannot be located by the class loader. Since there is no input validation or pre-check, any of these exceptions can be thrown during the forName call.
